positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a validation system to verify existence of call artifacts in S3 and Cassandra, improving turn-around time for investigations in ECI Foundations.
Implemented RESTful API endpoints using Java and Spring Boot, reducing overall turn-around time for investigations by multiple teams.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate the validation system, enhancing overall product reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Java · Back-end Operations · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer Tech Fellow, Advanced Web Development
positions.description:
Provided technical support for Web 103 course, covering advanced topics in web development.
Assisted students with dynamic data management, authentication, and deployment best practices.
Conducted code reviews and provided feedback to improve students’ coding skills and practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Databases · Communication · Community Outreach · Programming Languages · Leadership · HTML · Collaborative Problem Solving · JavaScript · Code Review · Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Built backend for a financial literacy web application using Express.js and Node.js.
Implemented database operations using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, ensuring efficient data modeling and secure
transactions.
Collaborated on RESTful API design, providing endpoints for frontend data retrieval and financial calculations.
Participated in Agile development processes, including daily stand-ups and sprint planning.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Programming Languages · Collaborative Problem Solving · React.js · Project Management · Project Planning · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · Code Review · Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Atlantic City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Contributed to the Virtual Immersion Environment Workspace (VIEW) project using Unity.
Implemented realistic environment and weather effects, increasing simulation fidelity.
Collaborated with the Airport Modeling and Simulation Branch to enhance training effectiveness.
